content.what_completed: Two units. (1) The day065 quantitative map: the EM-squeeze live-window structure on the band, in exact closed form - a hypothetical off-pair could be squeezed at run N only if N lies in W = (N1, min(N2, N3)) where the S3 face is possible (wallLo(N) < wire), the S1 leg is possible (fill(N) > own - MfR = 0: S1 needs fill >= dev >= flo = own), and the pin is possible (wallLo(N) > own). The map shows W is EMPTY at every band point: N1 >= N2 follows from the in-body S4 strict gap (wire < own) alone, so the S3-impossible region N < N1 reaches at least as far as the S1-dead crossing N2 - the two kill-regimes {S3 dead: N < N1} and {S1 dead: N >= N2} cover every run, with the pin region {wallLo > own} sitting strictly inside the S3-dead region. (2) T4OffLJ: the formal total-exhaustion record - the face-premise pair {S3 face, pin} is internally inconsistent at every run (S2, A2c-exact form), in the endpoint's zeta shape with the bridge from body (S3), plus the weak-pin face-death extension (S1). The 0262 record (T4OffLI) proved the THREE-premise set {bridge, S3 face, pin} inconsistent (the bridge as a premise); 0266 drops the bridge from the premise list entirely - the face pair alone is inconsistent, in body, no pin fact.
content.why_it_matters: The 0252-0262 EM-squeeze program (the entire 0123-family / Q2-decoupled / all-runs line) is now EXHAUSTED IN BODY IN ITS STRONGEST FORM: no squeeze instance at any run N on the band at target height is premise-consistent, and no hypothetical off-pair above the frontier can enter the squeeze machinery at ANY run - the A2c bridge (0265) and the face-premise internal inconsistency (0266 S2/S3) together close the last cited-premise and premise-structure doors. The hOffCPT2 terminal face (no off-pair above tPT2) now stands on the NON-EM residue ONLY: (a) board / zeta-data-class records above tPT2 (the B24/B25 conveyor - external, board idle at the TEN family contact, watcher armed), or (b) a genuinely new argument outside the EM kernel entirely - a direct lower bound on |zeta(1/2 - d0 + it)| at height t >= tPT2, d0 <= posReserveD0max, that does not route through the EM truncation cycle at all (research scale: the remaining open mathematics - the high-mass-pair regime, where the fill exceeds the wire wall at every pin-capable run by the 0259/0262/0266 chains). This is the exact residue named in 0261/0262, now with the EM class fully quantified: day065 shows the margin is total (36/36 points, window empty, tightest log-margin 0.094 at the S4-gap corner (1e3, 1/200)).

The pairs it would have excluded (low-mass, fill <= wire) cannot exist at any run by S2; the remaining pairs (high-mass, fill > wire at pin-capable runs) were never within the squeeze's reach - 0260/0262 said this at the pinned runs, 0266 says it at all runs without the pin premise.

The probe's N2 = N3 coincidence (to all printed digits) is expected: wallLo(N) = (1/2)N^-sig - t2 - t3 with t2 + t3 <= 6.1e-15 relative (layer 2), so the wallLo-own and fill-own crossings coincide; the S1-dead region and the pin region have the same boundary to measured precision.
